enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.desc: Keep niri's Overview backdrop color synced to the current Noctalia palette.

targetFile.label: Target file
targetFile.desc: The niri config file this plugin writes the overview block to. It is never merged into your main config.kdl automatically.

setup.title: One-time setup
setup.body: Add this line to your niri config.kdl, then remove any existing 'overview' block from it: include "{path}"
